name: HEAO-1
summary: Historical high-energy astronomy survey satellite whose X-ray background observations provide archive-based constraints on light-dark-matter annihilation and decay.
detection_principle: Multiple X-ray and gamma-ray instruments measure diffuse sky spectra; theoretical reanalyses test the allowed additional dark-matter radiation.

collaboration.name: HEAO-1 collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Only examples of lead or participating institutions directly established by the sources are listed. This is not a complete collaboration list, and listing does not imply equal institutional roles.

results.summary: Diffuse data have been used to constrain light-dark-matter models.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
